title: Automorphism count and inseparable factor of finite normal field degree
statement: Let $E/k$ be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension] of characteristic $p>0$ [def-pc-field-characteristic], and assume it is normal: the minimal polynomial of each element over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] splits into linear factors over $E$. Fix an algebraic closure $\overline E$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], with the composite $k$-algebra structure. Let $S\subseteq E$ be the subfield of elements separable algebraic over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. Put $s=|\operatorname{Hom}_{k\text{-alg}}(E,\overline E)|$ and $d=[E:S]$, where degrees are vector-space dimensions [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Then $|\operatorname{Aut}_k(E)|=s$, $[E:k]=s d$, and $d=p^c$ for some integer $c\geq0$.

mathlib_match.how: One declaration per clause, read in the pinned source: Normal.algHomEquivAut (Mathlib/FieldTheory/Normal/Defs.lean:207-219), with F=k and K₁ the chosen algebraic closure of E, gives the first equality by cardinality of its equivalence. Field.finSepDegree_eq_of_isAlgClosed (Mathlib/FieldTheory/SeparableDegree.lean:237-240) identifies the embedding count s into this chosen algebraically closed field with Field.finSepDegree k E; the finite extension supplies Algebra.IsAlgebraic. The degree d is Field.finInsepDegree k E, definitionally the finrank over separableClosure k E (Mathlib/FieldTheory/SeparableClosure.lean:281). Rewriting Field.finSepDegree_mul_finInsepDegree (PurelyInseparable/Basic.lean:588-596) by this identification gives the second clause. finInsepDegree_eq_pow (same file:497-499) at q=p gives the third; the positive field characteristic supplies ExpChar k p. No perfection or separability of E/k is assumed.
